Salt Lake City, UT | July 26–30, 2026 | All times MDT

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
[Download a printable PDF version](detailed.pdf)
:::

Every individual talk/poster from the ESA 2026 program matching aquatic ecology (marine, coastal, wetlands, lakes, rivers/streams, estuaries, freshwater, and related topics). Sorted by date, time, room, and title. Entries still marked "CANCELLED" in the original program are left as-is.

```{r}
library(readr)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

df <- read_csv("data/detailed.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

fmt <- if (knitr::is_latex_output()) "latex" else "html"

k <- kbl(df, format = fmt, booktabs = TRUE,
         longtable = (fmt == "latex"), align = "l",
         caption = paste0("Total talks/posters found: ", nrow(df)))

if (fmt == "latex") {
  k <- k |>
    kable_styling(
      latex_options = c("striped", "repeat_header", "hold_position"),
      stripe_color = "gray!10",
      font_size = 8
    ) |>
    column_spec(1, width = "0.7in") |>
    column_spec(2, width = "1.0in") |>
    column_spec(3, width = "0.7in") |>
    column_spec(4, width = "0.7in") |>
    column_spec(5, width = "4.3in") |>
    column_spec(6, width = "1.3in")
} else {
  k <- k |>
    kable_styling(
      bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed", "responsive"),
      full_width = TRUE
    )
}

k
```
